note_sections.t: Persistent prostate-specific antigen elevation alongside previously documented high-grade histology necessitates clinical re-assessment.

Osteoarthritis symptoms are occasionally managed with paracetamol taken as needed. Additional healthcare visits included a recent endocrinology thyroid panel yielding stable values and a pain clinic consultation for chronic right shoulder discomfort, both unrelated to his urological status. Systemic complaints, weight fluctuations, or skeletal pain are denied, with overall functional status remaining robust.
